title: Montserrat
text: Montserrat is a stunningly beautiful mountain range in Catalonia that houses monks of the Benedictine abbey. Along with gorgeous views outside, the museum and Basilica are awe inspiring. Don’t miss it!
author: hopej218

title: A great day out
text: If you are in Barcelona consider David for your guide. He is superb, has amazing knowledge of Spanish and Catalan culture, cuisine, art, architecture, places people you name it. Enjoy a few days with a true expert
author: cannandale

title: Montserrat day
text: David was the perfect guide for Montserrat and his knowledge of the tour was incredible. He knew so many facts and information that only a guide with an interest in sharing knowledge would know. Despite the rain at times , he altered activities to accommodate the weather but we still were able to see everything we wanted and hike back from the cross on the hill. His tips for us did not end when the day ended. We had also hired him for the next day. He gave us restaurant and wine suggestions too!
author: Barbara B

title: David is the best
text:
